name: customer-decision-reminders
description: CD-11 daily customer decision reminders for one tenant: answer reminders the day before and on an agenda's respond-by date, and override-closing notices two days before a date deadline, sent through each decider's bound channel (fixed templates via sendToCustomer and the outbound approval gate); deciders without a bound channel become operator inbox tasks. Install into a tenant with `pnpm kyberion customer-decision reminders --install --tenant <slug>`; Chronos runs it only after a human approves its project trust.
